frases.it: AVVISO AI PASSEGGERI: il volo AZ 614 per Palermo partirà alle 18:40, con cinquanta minuti di ritardo.
frases.es: AVISO A LOS PASAJEROS: el vuelo AZ 614 hacia Palermo saldrá a las 18:40, con cincuenta minutos de retraso.
frases.en: The flight AZ 614 to Palermo will leave at 18: 40, 50 minutes late.

frases.it: L'imbarco comincia alle 18:00 alla porta dodici.
frases.es: El embarque comienza a las 18:00 en la puerta doce.
frases.en: The shipment starts at 6: 00 at gate 12.

frases.it: I passeggeri con bagaglio da registrare devono presentarsi al banco entro le 17:30.
frases.es: Los pasajeros con equipaje para facturar deben presentarse en el mostrador antes de las 17:30.
frases.en: Passengers with check-in baggage must be present at the counter before 17: 30.

frases.it: Chi ha già fatto l'accettazione online può andare direttamente ai controlli di sicurezza.
frases.es: Quien ya haya hecho la facturación en línea puede pasar directamente a los controles de seguridad.
frases.en: Anyone who has already made the online billing can move directly to security controls.

frases.it: Per informazioni e assistenza, rivolgersi al punto informazioni vicino all'uscita B.
frases.es: Para información y asistencia, dirigirse al punto de información junto a la salida B.
frases.en: For information and assistance, please contact the information point next to exit B.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: air transport and passenger warnings

bloques.pregunta: What new time is the departure of the flight to Palermo scheduled?

opciones.explicacion: The release formally indicates: «il volo AZ 614 per Palermo partirà alle 18:40».
At 18: 00 the boarding at the appropriate door begins, not the departure of the plane.
17: 30 is the time limit for checking luggage on the counter.

bloques.pregunta: What time does the process of access on board passengers start?

opciones.explicacion: The notice points out: «L'imbarco comincia alle 18:00 alla porta dodici».

opciones.texto: At 18: 40 at the same time as the take-off.
opciones.explicacion: The boarding takes 40 minutes before the actual departure.

opciones.texto: At 17: 30 together with the billing closure.
opciones.explicacion: At that time, the luggage reception is completed.

bloques.pregunta: What travelers have a duty to be on the counter before 17: 30?

opciones.texto: Those who must send and check luggage packages.
opciones.explicacion: The standard is: «I passeggeri con bagaglio da registrare devono presentarsi al banco entro le 17:30».

opciones.texto: All passengers with tickets regardless of their situation.
opciones.explicacion: Those who do not carry bags to check can pass directly to security.

opciones.texto: Exclusively those who do not have a valid electronic ticket.
opciones.explicacion: It applies to any traveller with wine-cellar packages.

bloques.pregunta: What advantage do those who have previously completed the online billing have?

opciones.texto: You can immediately go to the security control without keeping a tail on a counter.
opciones.explicacion: The notice states: «può andare direttamente ai controlli di sicurezza».

opciones.texto: They have a preference to select any free seats in the cabin.
opciones.explicacion: It does not grant seat privileges, but rather agility of passage.

opciones.texto: They can board two hours in advance of the others.
opciones.explicacion: The shipment starts for everyone at 18: 00.

bloques.pregunta: Where should travellers who require additional assistance or information go?

opciones.texto: To the information point next to Exit B.
opciones.explicacion: The instruction says: «rivolgersi al punto informazioni vicino all'uscita B».

opciones.texto: Straight to the flight commander's command booth.
opciones.explicacion: The attention is given at the airport service points.

opciones.texto: To the central police station at the outside terminal.
opciones.explicacion: The traveller's care desk is located next to Exit B.

bloques.pregunta: How long is the official delay accumulated by the flight on the notice?

opciones.texto: Fifty minutes from the regular schedule.
opciones.explicacion: The notice explicitly stands out: «con cinquanta minuti di ritardo».

opciones.texto: Of two full hours due to adverse weather causes.
opciones.explicacion: The reflected delay is exactly 50 minutes.

bloques.frase: I passeggeri devono presentarsi alla porta dodici
bloques.explicacion: Standard transport design with the «dovere» modal verb.

intro: It interprets formal notices in transport terminals with changes in hours, boarding doors and slogans.
